mechanism: Probenecid inhibits renal tubular secretion of ketorolac, significantly increasing ketorolac plasma concentrations and half-life while also elevating risk of NSAID-related nephrotoxicity.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, reduce ketorolac dose by 50% and monitor renal function closely, as the combination substantially increases risk of renal impairment and ketorolac toxicity.
